scripts.test: esbuild src/sftp.test.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=.sftptest.mjs --log-level=error && node --import 'data:text/javascript,globalThis.self=globalThis' .sftptest.mjs; code=$?; rm -f .sftptest.mjs; exit $code

scripts.test:sort: esbuild src/sort.test.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=.sorttest.mjs --log-level=error && node .sorttest.mjs; code=$?; rm -f .sorttest.mjs; exit $code
